title: Registratie van beroep en opleiding van patienten in ziekenhuizen 1992-1993
authors: Popping, R., Rijksuniversiteit Groningen * Groningen, Fac. sociale wetenschappen (primary investigator)
contributors: R. Popping, Sociologisch Instituut, R.U. Groningen (depositor)
Programma commissie sociaal economische gezondheidsverschillen (research initiator)
Telephone control-interview by specially trained university students (data collector)
descriptions: Investigation to find the best method to register occupation and educational level of new patients at the intake desks of hospitals. Five different methods have been compared regarding reliability and duration of the registration Background variables: basic characteristics/ occupation/employment/ education
